speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. You are presenting with generalized fatigue, severe pruritus, and abnormal liver function tests. To begin narrowing down the cause, how long have you been experiencing these symptoms, and have you noticed any changes in your urine or stool color?

speaker: Patient
text: 32-year-old male. The patient reports a 2-month history of increasing generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. He has known hypertension and was diagnosed with ulcerative colitis 5 years ago. He mentions being sexually active with 2 female partners and inconsistent condom use.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Primary Biliary Cholangitis (PBC) is unlikely given the male gender and 2-month acute onset; the combination of severe pruritus, fatigue, abnormal LFTs, and risk factors for HIV/STIs raises suspicion for HIV-associated cholangiopathy, viral hepatitis B or C, or drug-induced liver injury. Given his inconsistent condom use and sexual history, please confirm if you have ever had a positive HIV test or been treated for an STI, and list all medications and supplements you are currently taking.
